mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the tightening signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which signals economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the labor market weakening signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the last quarter signals strong economic demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances despite the positive GDP signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over two months signals a supply shock, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the supply shock signal.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs in a month, it signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the strong labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% in a month, it signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator for broader economic demand and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the housing market expansion signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and CPI (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure coupled with tight monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with inflationary pressure
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the inflationary pressure and tight monetary policy signal.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) both increase over the last quarter, it signals strong economic demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and RSAFS increase over last quarter
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the strong economic demand signal.
